title: Tesla Sells Fewer Cars Every Year. So Why Is It Worth So Much? #shorts

scenes.text: Toyota sells over six times more cars than Tesla. Yet Tesla is worth about six times more than Toyota.
Tesla's sales peaked in twenty twenty-three. Then they fell two years in a row.
And last quarter, its profit fell forty-three percent.
So why is it worth one and a half trillion dollars? Investors aren't really betting on cars. They're betting on robot taxis and robots.
Its robot taxis have driven nearly two million miles with no one supervising. And research spending jumped sixty-nine percent.
Skeptics say it could take years to pay off. Fans say cars were never the point.
Car company, or robot company? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
